meta.source: U.S. Census Bureau, 2020 ZCTA to County Relationship File
meta.format: counties[countyFips] = the ZIP codes (ZCTAs) in that county, space-separated; invert it for ZIP -> county (a ZIP listed under several counties is in all of them). names[countyFips] = Census county name, only for counties that share a ZIP with another county.
meta.note: ZIP code -> county FIPS, from the U.S. Census Bureau 2020 ZCTA-to-county relationship file (a U.S. government work, not copyrighted). ZCTAs (ZIP Code Tabulation Areas) approximate USPS ZIP codes but are not the same thing: PO-box-only and single-building ZIPs have no ZCTA and are absent here, ZIP boundaries change after 2020, and a ZCTA is built from census blocks, so its edges can differ from mail delivery routes. A county is listed for a ZIP when it holds at least the threshold share of that ZCTA's land area (smaller slivers are ignored). Use it to confirm a plan's county-based service area, not as an address lookup; 'names' carries county names only for ZIPs in several counties.
